item.title: US captures Venezuela's leader and his wife in stunning operation and plans to prosecute them
item.description: Hours after a military operation that plucked Nicolás Maduro from power, Trump said that the U.S. would run Venezuela at least temporarily and tap its oil reserves.

item.title: Seahawks secure No. 1 seed in NFC and division title with dominant 13-3 win over 49ers
item.description: Zach Charbonnet scored on a 27-yard run in the first quarter and Seattle shut down the high-powered San Francisco offense in a 13-3 victory over the 49ers on Saturday night that secured the No. 1 seed for the Seahawks in the NFC playoffs.

item.title: Trump's plan to seize and revitalize Venezuela's oil industry faces major hurdles
item.description: President Donald Trump's plan to take control of Venezuela's oil industry and ask American companies to revitalize it after capturing President Nicolás Maduro in a raid isn't likely to have a significant immediate impact on oil prices.

item.title: 'Tron: Ares' to roll onto Disney+ for the new year
item.description: Return to the grid. "Tron: Ares" begins streaming this month, exclusively on Disney+.

item.title: Hundreds march in silence to honor victims of Swiss bar fire that left 40 dead
item.description: Somber mourners, many with reddened eyes, filed silently out of the chapel to organ music after the hourlong Mass at the Chapelle Saint-Christophe in Crans-Montana.

item.title: American tourists stranded across the Caribbean after airspace was closed for the capture of Maduro
item.description: American Airlines is adding 3,000 additional seats by adding flights and using larger planes in the Caribbean region. JetBlue says it expects to resume normal operations as well.

item.title: Dispute spills into new year over who controls historic Viet Museum in San Jose
item.description: There's an ongoing dispute spilling into the new year over who will run the Viet Museum at History Park in San Jose, and the new year could mean big changes. San Jose's Viet Museum could change hands if dueling groups don't come to a deal.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Level 2 storm brings more rain overnight through tomorrow
item.description: Our next round of rain will begin just after midnight tonight. This will be another Level 2 storm on the exclusive ABC7 Storm Impact Scale, and it will bring moderate rainfall and downpours, along with wind gusts ranging from 25 to 40 miles per hour through the morning commute.

item.title: Cuba says 32 Cuban officers were killed in US operation in Venezuela
item.description: A U.S. military operation in Venezuela killed 32 Cuban officers over the weekend, the Cuban government said Sunday in the first official death count provided.

item.title: Maduro to appear in Manhattan federal court on Monday for arraignment on alleged drug charges
item.description: A four-count indictment charged ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro with leading a 25-year narco-terrorism conspiracy.
